resources.string: Android 14+ can support third-party credential providers. Actual behavior depends on the device, browser and password manager.
Third-party provider support is limited on older Android versions. You can still test this browser; this is not a claim that passkeys are unavailable.
Set up and unlock your intended password manager, then review your credential providers in system settings. Returning here does not confirm a settings change.
The dedicated credential settings could not be opened on this device. System settings were opened instead; search for passwords, passkeys or autofill.
Open our test website, create a test passkey, then verify it. Observe which credential provider the browser uses.
This creates a real test passkey in your password manager. It may sync to other devices. Delete the test entry manually afterward.
Complete both steps in the browser. If you have returned, confirm your result below. The app does not receive the website result automatically.
Did you create and verify the test passkey using your intended provider? Any previous unfinished attempt remains unconfirmed.
This is your confirmation of this browser test, not proof that every app, browser or credential provider works.
Refreshing or clearing the test page removes its local data, not the passkey. In your password manager, delete the WebAuthn test entry for acp-fixer.aitiotekt.com.

A cancelled prompt, missing provider, locked password manager, browser limitations or network failure can interrupt the test. Check setup and complete both website steps. A failed test does not establish an OEM fault.

If the intended provider remains unavailable, use ACP Fixer on a computer for further diagnosis. Prepare Android SDK Platform-Tools, enable USB debugging and explicitly authorize the device. Diagnose first; inspect risks and recovery before confirming any change. This mobile app never repairs settings.

No device IDs, app lists or vault data are read. The website verifies responses locally; GitHub Pages may log file requests and IP addresses. Your password manager may sync test credentials. Android results are user-reported.
Could not open the external app. Install or enable a browser, or open system settings manually, then retry.
